canonicalLessons.description: Minna no Nihongo Shokyu 1: 23-dars: Shart va Vaqt (Qachonki / Qilsa). Darsda 42 ta yangi so'z, audio talaffuzli Furigana misollar va 5 ta asosiy grammatik formula o'rganiladi.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Minna Shokyu 1: 21–25 Darslar (Fikr, Aniqlovchi gaplar va Shart)
canonicalLessons.title: 24-dars: Muruvvat va Yordam (Bermoq, Olib bermoq)
canonicalLessons.description: Minna no Nihongo Shokyu 1: 24-dars: Muruvvat va Yordam (Bermoq, Olib bermoq). Darsda 22 ta yangi so'z, audio talaffuzli Furigana misollar va 4 ta asosiy grammatik formula o'rganiladi.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Minna Shokyu 1: 21–25 Darslar (Fikr, Aniqlovchi gaplar va Shart)
canonicalLessons.title: 25-dars: Shartli mayl va Davomiylik (Tara va Temo)
canonicalLessons.description: Minna no Nihongo Shokyu 1: 25-dars: Shartli mayl va Davomiylik (Tara va Temo). Darsda 20 ta yangi so'z, audio talaffuzli Furigana misollar va 5 ta asosiy grammatik formula o'rganiladi.

canonicalLessons.title: 26-Dars: 〜んです / 〜んですが (Izoh, sabab va iltimos bildirish)
canonicalLessons.description: Og'zaki nutqda sabab, vaziyat va izoh berishda qo'llaniladigan 〜んです strukturasi, muloyim iltimos (〜ていただけませんか) va maslahat so'rash (〜たらいいですか).

canonicalLessons.title: 27-Dars: 可能動詞 (Qobiliyat va imkoniyat fe'llari: 〜られる / 〜れる)
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'llarning imkoniyat/qobiliyat shakli (Kanou-doushi), obyektga 'が' qo'shimchasi, 見える va 聞こえる ning farqi hamda 〜しか〜ない cheklovi.

canonicalLessons.title: 28-Dars: 〜ながら / 〜ています (Odat) / 〜し、〜し (Sabablarni sanash)
canonicalLessons.description: Bir vaqtning o'zida ikkita ishni bajarish (〜ながら), doimiy takrorlanuvchi odat va faoliyat (〜ています), hamda bir nechta sabab va sifatlarni biriktirish (〜し、〜し).

canonicalLessons.title: 29-Dars: 自動詞・他動詞 (O'zlik va o'zgalik fe'llari) / 〜てしまいました
canonicalLessons.description: Harakat natijasida yuzaga kelgan joriy holatni ifodalash (自動詞＋ています) hamda ish-harakatning to'liq tugashi yoki pushaymonlik (〜てしまいました).

canonicalLessons.title: 30-Dars: 他動詞＋てあります / 〜ておきます (Tayyorgarlik choralari)
canonicalLessons.description: Birov tomonidan maqsadli bajarilgan ish natijasi (他動詞＋てあります), kelgusi ishlar uchun oldindan tayyorgarlik ko'rish (〜ておきます), hamda 'まだ〜ています'.

canonicalLessons.title: 31-Dars: 意向形 (Volitional form) / 〜と思っています / 〜つもりです
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'lning xohish-istak shakli (Ikou-kei: 〜よう), uzoq muddatli niyatni bildirish (〜と思っています), qat'iy reja (〜つもりです) va rasmiy jadval (〜予定です).

canonicalLessons.title: 32-Dars: 〜ほうがいいです (Maslahat) / 〜でしょう / 〜かもしれません
canonicalLessons.description: Foydali maslahat berish (〜た/ない ほうがいいです), ob-havo va ehtimollarni taxmin qilish (〜でしょう - 80% ishonch) hamda noaniq taxmin (〜かもしれません - 50% ehtimol).

canonicalLessons.title: 33-Dars: 命令形・禁止形 (Buyruq va taqiq) / 〜という意味です
canonicalLessons.description: Erkaklar nutqi, favqulodda vaziyat va sportdagi qat'iy buyruq (Meirei-kei) va taqiq (Kinshi-kei), belgilar ma'nosini tushuntirish (〜という意味です) va boshqalar so'zini yetkazish.

canonicalLessons.title: 34-Dars: 〜とおりに (Xuddi shunday) / 〜あとで (Keyin) / 〜て・ないで
canonicalLessons.description: Ko'rsatilgan yoki eshitilganidek bajarish (〜とおりに), bir ish yakunidan so'ng boshqasini qilish (〜あとで), hamda biror holatsiz/holatda harakat qilish (〜ないで).

canonicalLessons.title: 35-Dars: 条件形 (Shart shakli: 〜ば) / 〜なら (Tavsiya va chegara)
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'l va sifatlarning shart mayli (Jouken-kei: 〜ば), otlar uchun 〜なら hamda maslahat so'rash (〜ばいいですか) va mutanosiblik (〜ば〜ほど).

canonicalLessons.title: 36-Dars: 〜ように (Maqsad) / 〜ようになります / 〜ようにします
canonicalLessons.description: Muayyan maqsadga erishish uchun harakat qilish (〜ように), yangi qobiliyat va odatning shakllanishi (〜ようになります), hamda o'ziga odat qilib olish (〜ようにします).

canonicalLessons.title: 37-Dars: 受身動詞 (Majhul nisbat: 〜られる) / 〜によって
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'lning majhul nisbati (Ukemi-kei: 〜られる), bevosita majhullik, noqulaylik/ziyon ko'rish majhulligi (Meiwaku ukemi) hamda ixtirochi/muallifni ko'rsatuvchi 〜によって.

canonicalLessons.title: 38-Dars: 動詞の名詞化 (Fe'lning otlashishi: 〜のは / 〜のが / 〜のを)
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'l harakatini gapda otga aylantirish (Nominalizatsiya: 〜の), uning xususiyatlarini tavsiflash (〜のは〜です), qobiliyat va qiziqish (〜のが好きです) hamda unutish/bilish (〜のを忘れました/知っています).

canonicalLessons.title: 39-Dars: 原因・理由 (Sabab-oqibat: 〜て / 〜で / 〜ので)
canonicalLessons.description: Hissiyotlar, tabiiy hodisalar va imkonsizlikning sababini ko'rsatish (〜て形 / 〜で), hamda xolis, muloyim sabab bildiruvchi 〜ので.

canonicalLessons.title: 40-Dars: 疑問詞＋か / 〜かどうか / 〜てみます
canonicalLessons.description: Gap ichidagi so'roq (Koshma gap: 疑問詞＋か), ikkilanish va noma'lumlik (〜かどうか), hamda tajriba qilib ko'rish (〜てみます).

canonicalLessons.title: 41-Dars: 授受動詞 (いただきます・くださいます・やります / 〜ていただきます)
canonicalLessons.description: Hurmat darajasiga ko'ra berish-olish fe'llari (いただきます, くださいます, やります), xizmat ko'rsatish (〜ていただきます) hamda o'ta muloyim iltimos (〜てくださいませんか).

canonicalLessons.title: 42-Dars: 目的 (〜ために / 〜のに使います)
canonicalLessons.description: Kuchli irodaviy maqsad (〜ために) hamda asbob-uskuna yoki buyumlarning nima maqsadga mo'ljallanganligini ifodalovchi 〜のに.

canonicalLessons.title: 43-Dars: 様態 (〜そうです: ...ko'rinadi, tuyuladi) / 行動の移動 (〜てきます)
canonicalLessons.description: Tashqi ko'rinish va alomatlarga qarab xulosa chiqarish (〜そうです: mazalidek ko'rinadi, yog'adiganga o'xshaydi) hamda biror joyga borib, ishni bajarib qaytish (〜てきます).

canonicalLessons.title: 44-Dars: 過度 (〜すぎます) / 難易 (〜やすい / 〜にくい) / 変化 (〜くします)
canonicalLessons.description: Me'yordan ortiq darajada oshib ketish (〜すぎます), ish-harakatning oson yoki qiyinligi (〜やすい / 〜にくい), hamda subyektning xohishi bilan holatni o'zgartirish (〜くします / 〜にします).

canonicalLessons.title: 45-Dars: 条件・仮定 (〜場合は) / 逆接 (〜のに: holbuki, kutilganga zid)
canonicalLessons.description: Muayyan vaziyat yoki hodisa ro'y bergan taqdirda (〜場合は), hamda kutilgan natijaga zid ravishda yuz bergan norozilik va taajjub (〜のに).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 10: 46–50 Darslar (Vaqt, Eshitish, Majburlash va Keigo)
canonicalLessons.title: 46-Dars: 局面 (〜ところです: Boshlanish/jarayon/yakun) / 直後 (〜ばかりです)
canonicalLessons.description: Harakatning ayni qaysi pallasida ekanligini bildirish (〜辞書形/ている/た形 ところです), hozirgina sodir bo'lgan voqea (〜ばかりです), hamda qat'iy ishonch bilan taxmin (〜はずです).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 10: 46–50 Darslar (Vaqt, Eshitish, Majburlash va Keigo)
canonicalLessons.title: 47-Dars: 伝聞 (〜そうです: Eshitishimcha) / 推量 (〜ようです: Ko'rinishidan)
canonicalLessons.description: Boshqalardan yoki ommaviy axborot vositalaridan eshitilgan xabarni yetkazish (〜そうです - Denbun) hamda his-tuyg'u va alomatlarga asoslangan xulosa (〜ようです).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 10: 46–50 Darslar (Vaqt, Eshitish, Majburlash va Keigo)
canonicalLessons.title: 48-Dars: 使役動詞 (Majburlash yoki ijozat berish: 〜させる) / 〜させていただけませんか
canonicalLessons.description: Fe'lning majburlash yoki ijozat berish nisbati (Shieki-kei: 〜せる / 〜させる) hamda o'ziga ruxsat so'rashning eng ehtiromli shakli (〜させていただけませんか).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 10: 46–50 Darslar (Vaqt, Eshitish, Majburlash va Keigo)
canonicalLessons.title: 49-Dars: 尊敬語 (Sonkeigo: Hurmat shakli) / お〜になります / 特殊尊敬語
canonicalLessons.description: Yuqori martabali shaxslar, mijozlar va kattalarning harakatini ulug'lash (Sonkeigo), maxsus hurmat fe'llari (いらっしゃる, 召し上がる, おっしゃる) va taklif shakli (お〜ください).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 10: 46–50 Darslar (Vaqt, Eshitish, Majburlash va Keigo)
canonicalLessons.title: 50-Dars: 謙譲語 (Kenjougo: Kamtarlik shakli) / お〜します / 特殊謙譲語
canonicalLessons.description: O'z harakatini kamtar tutib, suhbatdoshni e'zozlash (Kenjougo), maxsus kamtarlik fe'llari (参る, 申す, いたす, 拝見する, 存じる) hamda o'ta xushmuomala Teineigo (ございます).

canonicalLessons.title: Passive Voice (受身形): Direct & Suffering Passive (迷惑の受身)
canonicalLessons.description: Majhul nisbat (Ukemi) va yapon tiliga xos "zararlangan/noqulaylik his qilgan majhul" shakli.

canonicalLessons.title: Causative Voice (使役形): 〜(さ)せる (Make / Let someone do)
canonicalLessons.description: Orttirma nisbat (Shieki): birovni qilishga majburlash yoki ruxsat berish.

canonicalLessons.title: Causative-Passive Voice (使役受身形): 〜(さ)せられる (Forced to do)
canonicalLessons.description: Majburan qildirildi: xohlamasa ham biror ishni qilishga majbur bo'lish (Shieki-Ukemi).

canonicalLessons.title: Preparatory Action: 〜ておく vs Resultant State: 〜てある
canonicalLessons.description: Oldindan tayyorlab qo'yish (Te oku) va kimdir tomonidan bajarilgan tayyor holat (Te aru).

canonicalLessons.title: Spontaneous Occurrence: 〜てしまう (Regret & Completion)
canonicalLessons.description: Tugallanganlik va afsuslanish ma'nolari (Te shimau / Chatte).

canonicalLessons.title: Decision & Rules: 〜ことにする vs 〜ことになる
canonicalLessons.description: Shaxsiy qat'iy qaror (koto ni suru) va tashqi qaror/qoida (koto ni naru).

canonicalLessons.title: Conscious Effort & Purpose: 〜ようにする vs 〜ように (In order that)
canonicalLessons.description: Harakat qilishga tirishish (you ni suru) va maqsad ergash gap (you ni).

canonicalLessons.title: Appearance & Hearsay: 〜そうだ (Looks like vs I heard that)
canonicalLessons.description: Tashqi ko'rinishdan xulosa (sou da - o'xshaydi) va eshitilgan xabar (sou da - deyishyapti).

canonicalLessons.title: Nuanced Reasoning & Contrast: 〜わりに(は) vs 〜くせに
canonicalLessons.description: Kutilganiga zid holat (warini - qaramay) va tanqidiy norozilik (kuseni - bo'la turib).

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Reading: Essay on Modern Work Culture in Japan
canonicalLessons.description: Yaponiyadagi zamonaviy ish madaniyati (Telework, Work-Life Balance) haqidagi N3 o'qish matni.

canonicalLessons.title: Keigo 1: Honorific Language (尊敬語 - Sonkeigo)
canonicalLessons.description: Mijoz va ustoz harakatini ulug'lovchi hurmat tili (Sonkeigo: いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, なさる).

canonicalLessons.title: Keigo 2: Humble Language (謙譲語 - Kenjougo)
canonicalLessons.description: O'z harakatini kamtar tutib suhbatdoshni yuksaltirish tili (Kenjougo: 参る, 申す, いたす, 拝見する).

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Intermediate Kanji: Abstract Concepts & Economy (経済, 政治, 影響, 関係, 相談)
canonicalLessons.description: Iqtisodiyot, jamiyat, ta'sir va munosabatlarni ifodalovchi N3 iyerogliflari.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Intermediate Kanji: Nature, Weather & Disasters (地震, 台風, 気温, 変化, 被害)
canonicalLessons.description: Zilzila, to'fon, harorat o'zgarishi va tabiiy ofatlar kanjilari.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Choukai: Quick Response (即時応答) Mastery
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N3 eshitish imtihonining eng tezkor bo'limi: qisqa iboraga bir zumda to'g'ri javob qaytarish.

canonicalLessons.title: Contrast & Opposites: 〜に対して vs 〜反面 (In contrast to vs On the flip side)
canonicalLessons.description: Taqqoslashdagi keskin farq (taishite) va bir narsaning ikki qarama-qarshi tomoni (hanmen).

canonicalLessons.title: Cause & Spontaneous Emotion: 〜によって (Means & Cause) & 〜せいで
canonicalLessons.description: Sabab va vosita (ni yotte - orqali/sababli) hamda ayblovchi salbiy sabab (sei de - dastidan).

canonicalLessons.title: Limitation & Scope: 〜ばかり vs 〜だけ vs 〜のみ
canonicalLessons.description: Faqatgina (dake - aniq chegara), faqat shu ishni qilaverish (bakari - salbiy ko'p takrorlanish).

canonicalLessons.title: JLPT N3 Dokkai: Mid-Length Reading & Logic Extraction
canonicalLessons.description: O'rta hajmdagi tahliliy matnlarni o'qib muallifning asosiy xulosasini topish.

canonicalLessons.title: Nuanced Expectations: 〜はずだ vs 〜わけだ vs 〜べきだ
canonicalLessons.description: Mantiqiy ishonch (hazu da - bo'lishi kerak), tabiiy xulosa (wake da - shunday ekanda), axloqiy burch (beki da).

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Kanji 1: Technology & Science (科学, 技術, 発明, 研究, 実験)
canonicalLessons.description: Fan, texnika, ixtiro va tadqiqotlarni ifodalovchi N3 iyerogliflari.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Kanji 2: Health, Body & Feelings (感情, 緊張, 複雑, 単純, 苦痛)
canonicalLessons.description: Tug'g'ular, asabiylashish, murakkablik va oddiylik iyerogliflari.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Conditionals Deep Dive: 〜と vs 〜たら vs 〜ば vs 〜なら
canonicalLessons.description: To'rtta yapon shart ergash shaklining aniq chegaralari va nozik farqlari.

canonicalLessons.title: Formal Writing Style (普通体 / だ・である調) & Academic Register
canonicalLessons.description: Insholar, ilmiy maqolalar va gazetalarning rasmiy yozma tili (Da / Dearu).

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Long Dokkai: Comparative Reading (統合読解)
canonicalLessons.description: Ikki xil muallifning bir mavzudagi fikrlarini qiyosiy tahlil qilish.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Choukai: Summary & Gist Comprehension (概要理解)
canonicalLessons.description: Eshitishning umumiy mazmun tushunish qismi: batafsil raqamlar emas, balki asosiy mavzuni anglash.

canonicalLessons.title: Star (*) Grammar Mastery: Scrambled Sentence Logic
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT ning yulduzcha (*) grammatik topshiriqlarini mantiqiy sintaksis orqali yechish texnikasi.

canonicalLessons.title: N3 Business Etiquette: Phone Calls & Appointment Confirmation
canonicalLessons.description: Yapon kompaniyasida telefon orqali muloqot va uchrashuvlarni tasdiqlash Keigosi.

canonicalLessons.title: Full JLPT N3 Simulation Exam: Moji, Goi, Bunpou & Dokkai
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N3 imtihonining to'liq formatli va vaqt chegaralangan simulatsiya testi.

canonicalLessons.title: JLPT N3 Capstone Grand Examination & N2 Promotion Certification
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N3 darajasini to'liq yakunlash va N2 darajasiga o'tish rasmiy sertifikatsiya sinovi.

canonicalLessons.title: Proportional Change: 〜につれて vs 〜にしたがって vs 〜に伴って
canonicalLessons.description: Boshqa biror hodisa o'zgargani sari ikkinchi hodisaning parallel o'zgarishi.

canonicalLessons.title: Compliance & Basis: 〜に応じて vs 〜に沿って vs 〜に基づいて
canonicalLessons.description: Talab va ehtiyojga mos holda (ni oujite), qoida va reja bo'yicha (ni sotte), dalilga asoslanib (ni motozuite).

canonicalLessons.title: Psychological Inability & Risk: 〜かねる vs 〜かねない
canonicalLessons.description: Rad etish muloyimligi (kaneru - qila olmayman) va xavfli ehtimol (kanenai - bo'lib qolishi mumkin!).

canonicalLessons.title: Absolute Impossibility: 〜っこない & Subjective Guess: 〜げ
canonicalLessons.description: Mutlaqo ilojsiz ekanini qat'iy ta'kidlash (kkonai) va tuyg'u belgisi (ge: sabishige, ureshige).

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Editorial Dokkai: Column Analysis on AI & Ethics
canonicalLessons.description: Sun'iy intellekt, avtomatlashtirish va insoniyat axloqi haqidagi gazeta tahririyat maqolasi tahlili.

canonicalLessons.title: Advanced Business Correspondence: 〜申し上げます & 〜存じます
canonicalLessons.description: Rasmiy korporativ yozishmalar va diplomatik ehtirom formulalari.

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Advanced Kanji: Macroeconomics, Commerce & Law (融資, 景気, 契約, 義務, 損害)
canonicalLessons.description: Bank krediti, bozor konyunkturasi, shartnomalar va huquqiy javobgarlik kanjilari.

canonicalLessons.title: Formal Negation & Concession: 〜ざるを得ない vs 〜わけにはいかない
canonicalLessons.description: Majburlikdan qilishdan o'zga chora yo'qligi (zaru o enai) va axloqan/vaziyat sababli qila olmaslik (wake ni wa ikanai).

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Choukai: Integrated Information Listening (統合理解)
canonicalLessons.description: N2 課題理解 va 統合理解: audio orqali vazifa, shartlar va keyingi harakatni aniqlash.

canonicalLessons.title: Unit 2 Checkpoint: Professional Japanese & Applied Skills
canonicalLessons.description: 1–10-darslarda o‘rganilgan N2 grammatikasi, biznes yapon tili, kanji va tinglab tushunish strategiyalarini mustahkamlash.

canonicalLessons.title: 〜にすぎない (Nothing more than / Merely)
canonicalLessons.description: Cheklov va kamtarinlik ifodasi: "Shunchaki ...dan iborat, xolos".

canonicalLessons.title: 〜をめぐって (Surrounding / Concerning a dispute)
canonicalLessons.description: Muammo yoki munozara atrofida bahslashish: "...atrofida / ...xususida".

canonicalLessons.title: 〜に際して (On the occasion of / Prior to)
canonicalLessons.description: Rasmiy tadbir yoki muhim hodisa munosabati bilan: "...munosabati bilan / ...olida".

canonicalLessons.title: Concession & Contrast: 〜ものの vs 〜とはいうものの
canonicalLessons.description: Kutilgan natijaga zid holatni rasmiy va yozma uslubda ifodalash: “... bo‘lsa-da / shunday deyilsa-da”.

canonicalLessons.title: 〜にほかならない (Nothing other than / Must be precisely)
canonicalLessons.description: Qat'iy xulosa: "...dan boshqa narsa emas / aynan ...dir".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 4: Reading & Listening in Social Context
canonicalLessons.title: Environmental & Technological Reading (環境・技術の読解)
canonicalLessons.description: Ekologiya va texnologiyaga oid N2 uzun matnlarni tahlil qilish va muallif g'oyasini topish.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 4: Reading & Listening in Social Context
canonicalLessons.title: 〜に先立って (Prior to / In advance of)
canonicalLessons.description: Tadbir yoki loyiha oldidan tayyorgarlik ko'rish: "...dan oldin / ...ga tayyorgarlik ko'rib".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 4: Reading & Listening in Social Context
canonicalLessons.title: 〜を契機に (Triggered by / Taking the opportunity of)
canonicalLessons.description: Katta o'zgarishga turtki bo'lgan hodisa: "...munosabati bilan / ...turtki bo'lib".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 4: Reading & Listening in Social Context
canonicalLessons.title: 〜を込めて (With all one's heart / Filled with)
canonicalLessons.description: Hissiyot va tilaklarni bag'ishlash: "...mehr bilan / ...tilaklar bilan".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 4: Reading & Listening in Social Context
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Listening Comprehension (聴解 - 即時応答 & 概要理解)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N2 即時応答・ポイント理解・概要理解 bo‘yicha real audio trekli mashqlar.

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Business Kanji (職・企・業・採)
canonicalLessons.description: Ish va biznesga oid N2 kanjilar (職, 企, 業, 採).

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Legal & Government Kanji (法・律・規・政)
canonicalLessons.description: Qonunchilik va davlat boshqaruvi kanjilari (法, 律, 規, 政).

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Compound Verbs (〜直す, 〜終える, 〜切る, 〜抜く)
canonicalLessons.description: Qo‘shma fe’llar: harakatni qaytadan bajarish, yakunlash, oxirigacha bajarish va qiyinchilikka qaramay davom ettirish.

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Onomatopoeia & Mimetic Words (擬音語・擬態語)
canonicalLessons.description: Tavsifiy taqlid so'zlar: "Sukkiri", "Giri-giri", "Waku-waku", "Ira-ira".

canonicalLessons.title: N2 Vocabulary Synthesis & Synonym Practice
canonicalLessons.description: Sinonimlar va ma'nodosh N2 so'zlarni moslashtirish mashg'uloti.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 6: N2 Final Assessment & N1 Bridge
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Keigo Mastery (尊敬語・謙譲語の総復習)
canonicalLessons.description: Hurmat va kamtarinlik iboralarining biznes darajasidagi to'liq sinovidan o'tish.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 6: N2 Final Assessment & N1 Bridge
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Grammar Integration (文法総合問題)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N2 darajasidagi barcha 50+ grammatik qoidalarni aralash test orqali tekshirish.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 6: N2 Final Assessment & N1 Bridge
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Information Retrieval (情報検索の読解)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N2 "Jouhou Kensaku" — E'lonlar, jadval va hujjatlardan tezkor ma'lumot qidirish.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 6: N2 Final Assessment & N1 Bridge
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Mini Mock Exam (模擬ミニテスト)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N2 bo‘limlari bo‘yicha qisqa formatdagi integratsiyalashgan sinov va vaqt boshqaruvi mashqi.

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 6: N2 Final Assessment & N1 Bridge
canonicalLessons.title: N2 Course Final Assessment & N1 Readiness Check
canonicalLessons.description: N2 kursi bo‘yicha yakuniy ichki baholash va N1 materiallariga tayyorlikni tekshirish.

canonicalLessons.title: Classical Concessions: 〜であれ / 〜であろうと (No Matter What / Be it)
canonicalLessons.description: Mumtoz yapon tili grammatikasining oliy ifodasi: qanday holat bo'lishidan qat'i nazar (De are / Dearou to).

canonicalLessons.title: Status & Duty: 〜たるもの vs 〜まじき (Fit for a leader vs Unforgivable for)
canonicalLessons.description: Sharafli maqomga loyiqlik (tarumono - mavqeiga xos) va mutlaqo yarashmaydigan xatti-harakat (majiki).

canonicalLessons.title: Uniqueness & Supreme Exclusivity: 〜ならでは vs 〜をおいて他にない
canonicalLessons.description: Faqat shu narsaga xos yagona fazilat (naradehawa) va undan o'zga muqobil yo'qligi (o oite hoka ni nai).

canonicalLessons.title: Extreme Completeness: 〜ずくめ vs 〜まみれ vs 〜だらけ
canonicalLessons.description: Mutlaqo qamrab olganlik (zukume - faqat shunday hodisalar), kirlanganlik (mamire - qonga/loyga belanish), tartibsizlik (darake).

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Deep Hermeneutics: Philosophical Treatise on Epistemology & Language
canonicalLessons.description: Til falsafasi, Vitgenshteyn va strukturalizm bo'yicha yapon tilidagi chuqur ilmiy traktat mutolaasi.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Master Kanji 1: Cognitive Discrepancy & Ambiguity (齟齬, 乖離, 曖昧, 葛藤, 矛盾)
canonicalLessons.description: Tafakkurdagi kelishmovchilik, uzilish, noaniqlik va ziddiyatlarni ifodalovchi N1 iyerogliflari.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Master Kanji 2: Statecraft, Vulnerability & Anxiety (憂慮, 脆弱, 覇権, 諮問, 隠蔽)
canonicalLessons.description: Davlat xavfsizligi, chuqur xavotir, zaiflik, gegemoniya va yashirish kanjilari.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Choukai: Integrated Lecture Synthesis (統合学術講義)
canonicalLessons.description: Universitet professori ma'ruzasidagi ko'p o'lchovli ilmiy sintezni to'liq tushunish.

canonicalLessons.title: Ultimate JLPT N1 Full Simulation Exam: Grand Mastery
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N1 oliy darajali to'liq vaqtli imtihon sinovi va xatolar ustida ishlash.

canonicalLessons.title: JLPT N1 Pinnacle Capstone: Native-Equivalent Master Certification
canonicalLessons.description: Yapon tili bo'yicha dunyo miqyosidagi eng oliy sertifikatlash bitiruv imtihoni (JLPT N1 Grand Pinnacle).

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 3: N1 Classical Grammar & Literary Forms
canonicalLessons.title: 〜たる者 (As a person in the position of / Being a...)
canonicalLessons.description: Burch va mas'uliyat: "Ma'lum oliy maqom egasi sifatida...".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 3: N1 Classical Grammar & Literary Forms
canonicalLessons.title: 〜に至る / 〜に至るまで (Reaching the point of / Down to)
canonicalLessons.description: Chegara va yakuniy bosqich: "...darajasigacha yetib borish".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 3: N1 Classical Grammar & Literary Forms
canonicalLessons.title: 〜を余儀なくされる (To be forced to / Compelled to)
canonicalLessons.description: Vaziyat taqozo etgan noiloj majburiyat: "...majburiyatida qolmoq".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 3: N1 Classical Grammar & Literary Forms
canonicalLessons.title: 〜が早いか (No sooner had... than / As soon as)
canonicalLessons.description: Vaqt bo'yicha ketma-ket dalahol sodir bo'lgan shiddatli harakat: "...bahamanoz / ...bilan birga".

canonicalLessons.unitTitle: Unit 3: N1 Classical Grammar & Literary Forms
canonicalLessons.title: 〜まじき (Unforgivable / Must not / Unbecoming)
canonicalLessons.description: Ahloqiy va kasbiy nuqtai nazardan aslo yo'l qo'yib bo'lmaydigan harakat.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Critical Philosophy Reading (哲学・思想の論説文)
canonicalLessons.description: Falsafiy va sotsiologik murakkab N1 matnlarini chuqur tahlil qilish.

canonicalLessons.title: 〜んがため / 〜んがために (In order to / For the purpose of)
canonicalLessons.description: Yuksak maqsad yo'lida harakat qilish: "...maqsadida / ...ni niyat qilib".

canonicalLessons.title: 〜をおいて (Apart from / Excluding)
canonicalLessons.description: Tengsiz va yagona ekanligini ta'kidlash: "...dan bo'lak / ...dan o'zga yo'q".

canonicalLessons.title: 〜極まる / 〜極まりない (Extremely / In the extreme)
canonicalLessons.description: Juda yuqori darajadagi holat yoki hissiyot: "O'ta ... / Cheksiz ...".

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Listening Mastery (聴解 - 統合理解 & 主張理解)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N1 Chokkai tinglab tushunish: Murakkab bir nechta spikerlar bahsi va muallifning yashirin g'oyasi.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Super-Advanced Kanji (2000+ Level)
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N1 ning 2000 ta kanji bazasidagi eng murakkab akademik va adabiy kanjilar.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Four-Character Idioms (四字熟語 Mastery)
canonicalLessons.description: 4 ta kanjidan iborat yapon klassik idiomalar: "Ichi-go ichi-e", "Shin-ro ku-kurou", "Ki-ten ret-tsu".

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Full Grammar Integration & Exceptions
canonicalLessons.description: N1 darajasidagi barcha 100+ grammatik qoidalarning kompleks sinovi.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Full Scale Simulation Mock Examination
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N1 Rasmiy Imtihonining to'liq simulyatsiyasi va baholanishi.

canonicalLessons.title: JLPT N1 Grand Master Certification & Graduation Exam
canonicalLessons.description: JLPT N1 Cho'qqisining to'liq va rasmiy oliy sertifikatlash va bitiruv imtihoni.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Dokkai: Media, Artificial Intelligence & Ethics (AIと倫理・科学論説文)
canonicalLessons.description: Sun'iy intellekt, axborot asri etikasi va inson ongi haqidagi ilmiy-falsafiy maqolalar tahlili.

canonicalLessons.title: High-Register Grammar: 〜にかまけて / 〜を皮切りに (In the wake of / Absorbed in)
canonicalLessons.description: N1 darajasining muhim grammatik konstruksiyalari: chalg'ish oqibatlari va katta tadbirlarning boshlanishi.

canonicalLessons.title: Absolute Emotions: 〜てやまない / 〜を禁じ得ない (Cannot help but feel / Ceaselessly)
canonicalLessons.description: Ichki his-tuyg'ularning to'lib-toshishi: to'xtovsiz samimiy tilaklar va o'zini tiyib bo'lmas tuyg'ular.

canonicalLessons.title: N1 Speed Reading & Information Retrieval (長文読解・情報検索総合マスター)
canonicalLessons.description: Murakkab reklamalar, shartnomalar, biznes hisobotlari va qiyosiy matnlarni tezkor skanerlash strategiyalari.

canonicalLessons.title: JLPT N1 Ultimate Crown Master Graduation (全領域総仕上げ・N1完全合格証明)
canonicalLessons.description: Nihongo Talk platformasining eng oliy bosqichi: N1 sertifikatsiyasi va yapon tili professional mutaxassis darajasi.
